# CircleDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasCircleDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasCircleDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasCircleDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasCircleDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A hub with a ring of labelled nodes and satellites

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCircleDiagram> CreateCircleDiagram( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCircleDiagram> CreateCircleDiagramFromGroups( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h, const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::vector<std::string>>>& groupedData);   // Convenience: one node per (label, [satellite labels]) pair.
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasCircleDiagram(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### enum `CircleDiagramDesign`

Structure preset. Designs change how the ring, nodes and satellites are arranged and decorated; they never change the node count, which is set independently with SetNodeCount(). Applying a design fills in defaults that every individual setter can still override afterwards.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `SatelliteWheel` | Hairline backbone, saturated nodes, 3 satellites each |
| `BandedWheel` | Thick coloured backbone band, icon-over-label nodes |
| `Custom` | Nothing pre-filled; assemble from the primitives |

### enum `CircleDiagramPaletteKind`

Categorical colour theme. Each named palette is a hue ramp sampled at N points, so any node count stays coherent - these are not fixed lists.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Vibrant` |  |
| `Ocean` |  |
| `Mint` |  |
| `Pastel` |  |
| `Midnight` |  |
| `Dark` |  |
| `Monochrome` |  |
| `Custom` | Colours supplied via SetCustomPalette(), cycled if short |

### enum `CircleBackboneStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoRing` | Nodes sit on an invisible circle |
| `Hairline` | Thin outline ring |
| `Band` | Thick filled band |

### enum `CircleLeaderStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoLeader` |  |
| `Solid` |  |
| `Dashed` |  |
| `Dotted` |  |

### enum `CircleNodeLabelPlacement`

Where a node's label is drawn relative to its disc.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Inside` | Wrapped inside the disc (references 1 and 2) |
| `Outside` | Parked radially outside the disc |
